description: Read-only specialist that performs exhaustive, unbridled production code scans of a module or package for runtime bugs, security risks, resource leaks, and API ergonomics
when_to_use: Invoke to scan an entire module, package, or subsystem for latent production bugs, architectural friction, or API/DevEx gaps. Do not invoke for narrow diff reviews (use prod-auditor or pr-reviewer) or to edit files.
